verdict.rationale: Hummingbird documents first-party APIs for its core objects: an Alerts API, a Case API for creating and updating cases, case listing and fetching, a batch case import API, and filing APIs to validate, file and monitor status. Much of the UI surface has no API evidence, including file attachments and renaming, comments and @-mentions, adding approvers, workflow configuration, analytics CSV exports, report history export and organization settings. No public OpenAPI spec was found at any probed path. Missing for 10: evidence of API coverage for attachments, comments, approvals, workflow configuration, analytics and settings; a published machine-readable API reference; independent confirmation of UI–API parity.
